text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh, hnnngh, heave-ho!!!!!! Hnnngh, 
hnnngh, heave-ho!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day. A mysterious, gigantic 
rectangular prism was brought in through 
the entrance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's, Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When you think of Valentine's Day, it's 
gotta be this, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it~! This is a gift 
wrapping.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Inside is homemade chocolate, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I asked why it had grown so large...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, you see~. I'm not used to handmade 
stuff, so I didn't know how much to do...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I didn't want to rely on the 
Mejiro maids, so I made it all the way to 
the end by myself!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Just open it and see, please!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From inside emerged a giant almond-shaped 
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is this shape supposed to be a thigh 
muscle? I don't really get the concept, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Would you... give it a try? Just as a 
taste test to start with...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Please... Dear God... I hope it suits 
their tastes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Snapping off a piece, I pop it into my 
mouth. And then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: R-Really!? Thank goodness~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I was super picky with the ingredients, 
you know! I even ran all the way to a 
distant town to buy them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If you thought it was delicious, that's 
such a relief... As long as Trainer is 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate was packed with everything 
that made Mejiro Ryan who she was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if its shape is imperfect, it has an 
honest flavor born of diligent effort 
without relying on others...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Go on, if you liked it, have another! 
There's plenty more where that came from!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, there's still plenty plenty plenty 
plenty plenty plenty plenty plenty more to 
go!
choice_data_list:
I'll take some of that thigh muscle 
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, these aren't thigh muscles~. They're 
a completely different shape, I tell you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Umm~, so, what I mean is~ what I was 
aiming for was~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's just call it a UFO chocolate. No 
matter how you look at it... that's about 
the best it gets."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought it looked like an almond, but it 
seems it was an almond-shaped UFO.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could she surprisingly be into the occult? 
I pondered that while thoroughly enjoying 
the meal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Actually... it was heart-shaped at first. 
But while I was kneading it, it kind of 
stuck together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I wanted to give you a big, 
giant heart! Like, 'Here you go, Trainer♪'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I-I kinda feel like... I'm saying 
something totally outrageous here..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whaaahaaaaah, there's no deeper meaning to 
it! That's a thigh muscle. It's thigh 
muscle chocolate!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we settled on the thigh 
muscles. For some reason, Mejiro Ryan's 
face turned bright red.
